title: Causally-Constrained Probabilistic Forecasting for Time-Series Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2604.17998v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Anomaly detection in multivariate time series is a central challenge in industrial monitoring, as failures frequently arise from complex temporal dynamics and cross-sensor interactions. While recent deep learning models, including graph neural networks and Transformers, have demonstrated strong empirical performance, most approaches remain primarily correlational and offer limited support for causal interpretation and root-cause localization. This study introduces a causally-constrained probabilistic forecasting framework which is a Causally Guided Transformer (CGT) model for multivariate time-series anomaly detection, integrating an explicit time-lagged causal graph prior with deep sequence modeling. translated_title: 基于因果约束的概率预测时间序列异常检测方法
translated_abstract: 多变量时间序列中的异常检测是工业监测领域的一项核心挑战，因为故障往往源于复杂的时间动态和跨传感器交互。尽管近期的深度学习模型，包括图神经网络和Transformer，已经展现出强大的实证性能，但大多数方法仍主要基于相关性，对因果解释和根因定位的支持有限。本研究引入了一个因果约束的概率预测框架，即因果引导Transformer（CGT）模型，用于多变量时间序列异常检测，该模型将显式的时滞因果图先验与深度序列建模相结合。对于每个目标变量，一个专用的预测模块采用由因果发现方法推导出的硬父节点掩码，将主要预测路径限制在因果图所支持的成因上，同时一个潜在高斯输出头用于捕获预测的不确定性。
tldr: 提出了一种因果引导Transformer（CGT）模型，通过将时滞因果图先验融入深度概率预测框架，实现了多变量时间序列异常检测中的因果解释与根因定位能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes a Causally Guided Transformer (CGT) model that integrates an explicit time-lagged causal graph prior with deep probabilistic forecasting, enabling causally interpretable anomaly detection and root-cause localization in multivariate time series.
